Apple___Apple_scab.name: Apple scab
Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Dark olive-green spots under ½ inch on leaves; badly hit leaves brown and drop.
cultural: Rake up and destroy fallen leaves
Apple___Apple_scab.nutrition: No fertiliser spray treats scab. Avoid heavy nitrogen that keeps leaves soft and wet longer.

Apple___Black_rot.name: Black rot (frogeye leaf spot)
Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Purple speck that grows into a tan centre with a dark ring, like a frog's eye.
cultural: Remove mummified fruit where the fungus overwinters
Apple___Black_rot.nutrition: Not a nutrient problem. Keep trees vigorous with balanced feeding.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.name: Cedar apple rust
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Raised bright orange-yellow spots on leaves.
cultural: Remove nearby red cedar or juniper galls

Apple___healthy.name: Healthy
Apple___healthy.symptoms: Uniform colour, no spots, lesions, mould or curling seen by the model.
cultural: Water at the base, keep foliage dry
Apple___healthy.nutrition: No fertiliser spray needed for disease. Keep soil-test-based NPK; avoid excess nitrogen, which makes soft growth that leaf diseases like.

product.kind: Fungicide (only if it is moving up the plant near tasselling)

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Reddish-brown powdery pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces.

actives: Only if severe on a susceptible hybrid: QoI or DMI

Grape___Black_rot.name: Black rot
Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown round leaf spots with a ring of tiny black dots inside a dark border.

product.kind: Fungicide (protect from bloom until berries colour)

cultural: Remove mummified berries and infected prunings before spring

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).name: Esca (black measles)
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe yellow or red bands between the veins, drying to brown.

actives: Wood infection cannot be eradicated by fungicide

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Dark brown irregular spots on older leaves.

product.kind: Fungicide (usually covered by the routine programme)
actives: Protectant used for main grape diseases (e.g. mancozeb)

cultural: Improve airflow by pruning and thinning
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.nutrition: Keep vines vigorous with balanced feeding.

cultural: Remove infected trees to stop spread
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).nutrition: Good tree care may prolong life but does not cure the tree.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot

Tomato___Early_blight.name: Early blight
Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Brown spots with target-like rings on lower leaves, ringed with yellow.
cultural: Mulch and water at the base
Tomato___Early_blight.nutrition: Keep N and P adequate; avoid excess potassium.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Late blight
Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large dark brown blotches with a grey-green edge; plants can collapse in cool wet weather.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.name: Leaf mold
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale yellow spots on top of the leaf, olive-green velvety mould underneath.

product.kind: Fungicide (before infection when humidity is high)

cultural: Vent and fan greenhouses; keep humidity under 85%

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria leaf spot
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Many small round spots with grey centres and dark edges on lower leaves.
cultural: Water at the base in the morning

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.name: Two-spotted spider mite
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling, bronzing and webbing; tiny moving dots under leaves.
cultural: Hose mites off with a strong water jet
Avoid pyrethroids and malathion, which flare mites
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.nutrition: Water-stressed plants suffer more: irrigate in hot, dry spells.

Tomato___Target_Spot.name: Target spot
Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Brown spots with light centres and concentric rings, larger than early blight's.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.name: Yellow leaf curl virus
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Young leaves yellow, curl and crumple; plants stunted and bushy.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.nutrition: Fertiliser will not cure a virus.
